description:
Topics: analysis of determinate and indeterminate structures under static loads including trusses, beams, frames, cables, and arches; drawing of shear and moment diagrams, influence lines; deflection calculation; virtual work method; Castiglioni's Theorem and force method.

*Indicates 1-hour labs are scheduled periodically throughout the term and students will be advised of the timing at the start of the term.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • CIVE220 - Mechanics of Solids I (1.5)
    • ENGR141 - Engineering Mechanics (1.5)
    • MATH200 - Calculus III (1.5)
preOrCorequisites:
• Completed or concurrently enrolled in all of:
    • MATH204 - Calculus IV (1.5)
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of CIVE 250, CIVE 350.
title: Structural Analysis
